## Unicode 16.0.0

- `16.0.0/LineBreakTest.txt` is the unmodified default UAX #14 conformance
  corpus from
  `https://www.unicode.org/Public/16.0.0/ucd/auxiliary/LineBreakTest.txt`.
  SHA-256:
  `910759a611a479f37df4f535d2e64d7589be3c5ac5f7491cf1fb4fa4cdb211e9`.
- `workspace/crates/typaxis-linebreak/src/unicode_linebreak_data.rs` is
  generated by `tools/generate_unicode_linebreak.py` from the pinned UCD
  inputs and hashes declared in that script.
